fact: In World Vision's 2019 financial year the Digital Attendance App, a web and mobile application developed by UNICEF and Sisitech that captures each student's daily attendance online or offline, was in an ongoing pilot in 3 primary schools in Puntland with the Response Innovation Lab and the Puntland Ministry of Education, the pilot schools moving from a paper attendance tracker; the ministry wanted it integrated with the EMIS.
title: World Vision Somali Programme Annual Report 2019
